evidence.fact: Forest Service lists elevation gain/loss of 3,420 ft for Humphreys Trail No. 151.
HikeArizona gives elevation gain of 3,313 ft for Humphreys Summit Trail #151.
Trail runs roughly 5 to 5.5 miles one way.
Hiking time about 3 to 4 hours one way.
Seasons listed as early summer to early autumn.

facts.value: July-September monsoon storms bring sudden heavy rain, wind and lightning; colder, windier above treeline

evidence.fact: Monsoon storms with rain, wind and lightning can build fast July through September; colder and windier above treeline.

facts.value: Arizona Snowbowl lot: Highway 180 for 7 miles to Forest Road 516 (Snowbowl Road)

evidence.fact: Directions: Highway 180 for 7 miles to Forest Road 516, the Snowbowl Road.

facts.value: Inside Kachina Peaks Wilderness (designated 1984); check Kachina Peaks Avalanche Center before snow-season travel

evidence.fact: Trail lies in the 18,960-acre Kachina Peaks Wilderness, designated 1984; check the avalanche center report first.

az_mt_humphreys_humphrey_s_peak_trail.note: FS prose says trail begins ~9,200 ft but its stats say 9,340 ft; used the stats. HikeArizona distance (10.25 mi) and time are round trip; distance not used.
